rows.text: Information on the meeting of the Monetary Policy Council on May 28-29,
The Monetary Policy Council held its meeting on May 28-29, 2002.
The Council was submitted the materials prepared by in public finance sector, money supply, lending and interest rates and the formation of prices and inflation expectations.
In reply to the Government proposals, the Monetary Policy Council discussed the principles of the exchange rate system performance in Poland.
The Council declared itself for maintaining the exchange rate system without changes.
Since the last meeting of the Monetary Policy Council the economic growth forecasts worldwide have not changed.

Considering these arguments, the Monetary Policy Council decided to:
Cut the minimum yield on 28-day open market operations from 9.5% to 9%;
Cut the rediscount rate from 11% to 10.5%;
Cut the lombard rate from 12.5% to 12%;
Cut the deposit rate from 6.5% to 6%;
Maintain its neutral position in monetary policy.
The next meeting of the Monetary Policy Council will be held on June 25-26.
